title: studio: duplicate API reads on entry (packages ×3, _drafts ×4, sys_user_preference ×3) — no shared query cache
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: production build of objectui `179f6fe9` (no StrictMode): opening a package from the Studio landing issued 19 API reads including duplicates.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- Landing → package → Data: `GET /api/v1/packages` ×3, `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` ×4, `GET /api/v1/meta/object` ×2, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_account` ×2.
- Home → Studio: `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user_preference` ×3 with the identical filter.
- Dashboard surface: `meta/object/showcase_task` ×3.
`fetchPackages()` has six independent call sites in app-shell with no shared cache.

## Expected

One read per key per navigation.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

A shared query cache (React Query / SWR or the existing store) keyed by URL with short staleness; route `fetchPackages` through it.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *duplicate requests packages drafts user preference query cache studio*: 3 hits (0 open, 3 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#5544 (closed) — closed 2026-08-22 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#5658 shared in-flight GET): same duplicate-request class on console boot; this card = Studio-entry residual
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: duplicate api requests studio · packages fetched three times · drafts four times · sys_user_preference repeated · query cache
